title: What it requires of each person
caption: Four failures, three missing skills, and each skill has a name.
board: The seam's contract card: receives 200 guests, 31 vegetarian, defined as no meat, fish or eggs; delivers dinner for 200 at 19:00; checked by the menu against the definition; ticked

skills-behind-the-failures.title: Skills behind the failures
skills-behind-the-failures.script: Let's go back to the board. Each of the four failures came from a skill that was missing in a person, and there are three skills in all. Each one has a name, and we take them one at a time.
